events.title: Attorney-General’s Lecture 2026
events.venue: Havelock Hall, Basement 2, The State Courts, 1 Havelock Square, Singapore 059724
events.outline: This event is organised by the Attorney-General's Chambers (AGC). This talk will be delivered by the former Attorney General of England and Wales and Advocate General for Northern Ireland, The Rt Hon Lord Richard Hermer KC. It will address the issue of the international rules-based system being under unprecedented strain, and discuss the myriad benefits that the rule of law, and the international rules-based order bring to the global community. He will also argue that the leadership of countries like Singapore and the UK is vital.

events.title: A Menu for IP Mediation – Choices and Options
events.outline: This event is organised by World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) – Arbitration and Mediation Center, Singapore Office. This panel explores how IP and technology disputes are best mediated, examining facilitative, evaluative and transformative approaches, whether parties should choose their preferred style in advance, and where AI may assist. Includes a dedicated ethics segment on neutrality and dual roles.

events.title: International Sports Law Conference 2026
events.outline: The International Sports Law Conference 2026 (Law Society of Singapore) connects sports governance and dispute resolution with global commercial law. Highlights include a Fireside Chat with Singapore's Law Minister and CAS's Director-General on Singapore's role in sports justice, plus sessions on Singapore as Asia's sports gateway and a panel on sports-commercial arbitration synergy. It underscores Singapore's commitment to integrity, rule of law, and advancing global sports administration standards.

events.title: Introduction to International Arbitration
events.venue: Intellectual Property Office of Singapore (IPOS), 1 Paya Lebar Link #11-03 PLQ 1, Paya Lebar Quarter, 408533, Singapore
events.outline: This course provides candidates with a foundational understanding of the general principles of International Arbitration, and how it relates to other dispute resolution processes. Candidates will be introduced to the legal framework governing International Arbitration, alongside good practice and procedure. Our lecturers bring hands-on experience in IP and technology-related disputes, offering candidates valuable real-world perspectives throughout the course.

events.title: Strategic Conflict Management for Professionals Module 1+
events.venue: Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) The Adelphi, 1 Coleman Street #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Strategic Conflict Management for Professionals Module 1 is an intensive two-day training programme to learn the foundations of interest-based mediation which focuses on the disputing parties’ interests and encourages a broader range of solutions. You will learn about the nature of conflicts and the most effective techniques to manage them. These fundamental dispute resolution strategies can be applied in diverse situations to manage work relationships within an organisation or with external parties, or to build stronger and more effective teams.

events.title: Certificate in Multi-Jurisdictional Tax and Structures
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute (WMI). This module examines how family offices navigate cross-border tax and regulatory environments. It covers key regimes across major jurisdictions, with a focus on Singapore’s Section 13 incentives, licensing and structuring considerations. Participants explore CRS, FATCA, global minimum tax, and emerging trends, applying insights through practical case studies on family office operations.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 2: Formal Restructuring Options+
events.outline: This module covers two formal restructuring options, namely Schemes of Arrangement (“SOA”) and Judicial Management (“JM”).

events.title: CBFL Seminar Series: Regulating Powerful Businesses: Regulation by Intentional Institutionalism
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: Responsive regulation has shaped regulatory practice for over three decades, yet repeated corporate failures expose its structural limits. This paper argues that the enforcement pyramid is ineffective for powerful institutions because it assumes genuine dialogue and normative engagement. It proposes Intentional Institutionalism, a framework that places corporate culture, leadership accountability, and proactive institutional design at the centre of effective regulation.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Senior Counsel Forum 2026 - Module 4: Conflicts in Relation to Two Existing Clients or Past Clients
events.outline: The Senior Counsel Forum, by the Law Society of Singapore, returns with six modules led by distinguished Senior Counsel. Topics include court submissions, duty to the court, disciplinary processes, conflicts of interest, common ethical scenarios, and English ethics practice. An invaluable opportunity for lawyers to learn best practices in legal ethics, delivered virtually via Zoom.

events.title: JLP - Cross-Examination and Experts+
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Develop essential and practical skills required to cross-examine witnesses in court proceedings, and how to deal with experts and use expert evidence in the course of a dispute.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Community Law Training Programme 2026 - Module 10: Family Violence
events.outline: This module focuses on the practical handling of family violence cases, including applications for Personal Protection Orders (PPOs) and the use of remedies under the Protection from Harassment Act (POHA) where appropriate. Adopting a community-law focused approach, the session examines how to assess risk, advise clients on available protection, and prepare cases responsibly in time-sensitive situations.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Artificial Intelligence and its Impact on the Legal Profession
events.outline: Does AI mean the end of lawyers? This webinar will address how artificial intelligence is impacting the legal profession – from its effects on the nature of legal practice, AI risk management, legal accountability and the ethical use of AI, as well as how legal roles may evolve in the future. Legal professionals will gain insights from an expert panel that includes representatives from private practice, academia and government, who will examine the current and emerging developments and how lawyers can prepare for AI-driven change.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Formulating Case Theory
events.outline: This session explores the formulation of a compelling case theory in criminal trials — a strategic framework that guides advocates from pre-trial preparation through to closing submissions. Participants will learn how to craft a coherent narrative that aligns with client instructions and ethical obligations, and why establishing a strong case theory early is essential for staying focused, addressing weaknesses, and making sound strategic decisions throughout the trial.

events.title: [NUS Law Bicentennial Lecture on the Rule of Law] Evolving Conceptions of the Rule of Law: The Singapore Experience
events.venue: Yale-NUS College Hall, NUS Law, UTown
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This address traces the evolution of the rule of law in Singapore, from its procedural foundations to a broader, substantive conception. It examines core principles underpinning stability and commercial credibility, and considers how Singapore adapts to globalisation, fragmentation and AI through enhanced legal coherence, access to justice, therapeutic justice, and international cooperation.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 10: Mastering Sentencing: Key Principles and Evolving Trends
events.outline:
The criminal defence counsel will understand the various factors that are considered by the Courts in the selection and calibration of the appropriate individual and global sentences.
This seminar equips criminal defence counsel with practical insights into sentencing objectives, frameworks, and how recent jurisprudence has shaped their application.

events.title: Public International Law Conference 2026
events.venue: The Law Society of Singapore (Members’ Lounge) ,28 Maxwell Road #01-03, Maxwell Chambers Suites Singapore 069120
events.outline: The post-World War II international order is under unprecedented strain as powerful states increasingly disregard international law, undermine multilateral institutions, and pursue national interests through military and economic force. Organised by the Public and International Law Committee of the Law Society of Singapore, this conference brings together practitioners, academics, and policy experts across four panels to examine what these developments mean for the international rules-based order and for Singapore and the ASEAN region.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 11: Mastering Examination: Techniques for Evidence-in-Chief, Cross-Examination, and Re-Examination
events.outline:
Witness testimony is the heart of any trial—shaped through evidence-in-chief, cross-examination, and re-examination. But in a world where truth isn’t always freely offered, skilled examination becomes essential.
In this dynamic session, seasoned practitioners share practical techniques and insights on drawing out compelling, reliable testimony.

events.title: Annual CPD Day 2026 (Part 1): The Inaugural Ethics and Innovation Forum
events.venue: Members' Lounge (The Law Society of Singapore)
events.outline: What does it mean to practise with integrity in an age of AI? Join us for an afternoon CPD programme that brings together the leadership of the Singapore Bar and the architects of its digital future for two focused sessions – offering frank perspectives on where the profession stands today, and what it takes to lead it forward.

events.title: The Singapore Torrens System After Baalman
events.outline: This seminar examines the law of easements under Singapore's Torrens system, highlighting recent developments in implied and court-created easements through landmark cases and expert commentary from contributors to The Singapore Torrens System After Baalman.

events.title: Loss of Profits Fundamentals
events.venue: Room 701, Level 7, NTUC Centre, One Marina Boulevard, Singapore 018989
events.outline: This event is organised by J.S. Held. Getting the quantum wrong can undo an otherwise winning case.  Loss of profits sits at the heart of commercial disputes, including breach of contract, shareholder rows, business interruptions, IP infringement and investment treaty arbitration.  This seminar gives legal practitioners the fundamentals needed to instruct experts effectively, pressure-test opposing calculations, and argue quantum with confidence.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 3: Informal Restructuring Options+
events.outline: This module covers the technical and legal aspects of informal restructuring, i.e., restructuring outside of formal court processes. Participants will learn how to change the composition and/or structure of a distressed debtor company’s assets and liabilities, without the Court’s intervention. The course also reviews both operational restructuring as well as financial restructuring, and how other issues arising from such an exercise need to be managed.

events.title: Tracing Crypto: From Blockchain to Courtroom
events.outline:
The event is organized by Selvam LLC and KordaMentha. This programme aims to equip participants with a foundational understanding of the following: 
• The key concepts and terminology relevant to digital assets and cryptocurrencies, and how blockchain transactions are recorded and traced on blockchain. 

• The current state of Singapore law regarding the classification of cryptocurrency as property and the principles governing the valuation of cryptocurrency in legal proceedings. 

• The practical application of Chainalysis Reactor and related tools for tracing the flow of cryptocurrency between addresses, and attributing addresses to real-world entities.

events.title: From Innovation to Impact: IP Commercialisation in Healthcare and MedTech
events.venue: Resmed Office @One-north 1 Fusionopolis Place, #07-10/16 Galaxis, Singapore 138522
events.outline: Healthcare innovation is transforming the way we diagnose, treat and deliver care. From AI-powered diagnostics and digital health platforms to connected medical devices, new technologies are transforming the way healthcare is delivered. But bringing these innovations to market takes more than great ideas – it requires the right IP strategy.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Directors in the Twilight Zone: Duties, Decisions and Liability as Insolvency Approaches
events.outline: This webinar examines how directors’ duties operate as insolvency nears, and when claims for breach of fiduciary duties may be pursued against former directors independently of statutory avoidance or clawback claims. Drawing on the recent decisions of Foo Kian Beng v OP3 International Pte Ltd (in liquidation) and Goh Jin Hian v Inter-Pacific Petroleum Pte Ltd (in liquidation), the speakers will highlight key legal principles and practical indicators of potential breaches of duty.

events.title: TechLaw.Fest 2026+
events.venue: Sands Expo & Convention Centre, 10 Bayfront Ave, Singapore 018956
events.outline:
This year, we will examine how core principles of fairness, accountability and access to justice can be upheld amid rapid technological change. Bringing together over 2,000 participants from more than 30 countries, TechLaw.Fest convenes legal professionals, technologists, policymakers and academics to exchange ideas, spark collaboration and shape the future of technology law and digital transformation.
TechLaw.Fest: where the Law of Tech meets the Tech of Law. Join us to find out how the practice of law and delivery of legal services will evolve and transform between East and West!

events.title: Executive Programme in Criminology and Criminal Justice+
events.venue: National University of Singapore (Kent Ridge Campus)
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline:
Criminological research is making fast progress in understanding the causes and prevention of crime, the impact of penal laws and sanctions on behaviour, the prediction of future risk, and the functioning of the criminal justice system.

The course is open to senior legal practitioners, including prosecutors, defence counsel, judges, and other criminal justice professionals/ stakeholders from Singapore.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Ponzi Insolvencies: Clawbacks, Investor Defences and Cross-Border Recovery
events.outline: This event is organised by INSOL International (Asia) Ltd. This webinar examines the legal, commercial and operational challenges arising from modern Ponzi insolvencies, including clawback litigation, investor defences, forensic investigations, asset tracing, digital asset recovery and cross-border recovery strategies. Drawing on recent legal developments and the speakers’ firsthand experience, it also considers the legal, forensic and commercial issues that influence successful recovery outcomes in complex domestic and cross-border frauds.

events.title: CML Seminar Series: Termination for Late Delivery in Charterparties: A Pause for Thought?
events.venue: The Executive Centre Level 22 Ocean Financial Centre 10 Collyer Quay Singapore 049315
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This seminar examines a hypothetical time charterparty dispute involving late delivery. It considers the conflict between delivery obligations and reasonable diligence, the nature of breach, and the legality of charterer termination. It highlights the innocent party’s decision-making period, shaped by contractual context, urgency, market conditions, performance, and potential prejudice. It also stresses reserving rights and properly framing termination notices, as termination is not automatic.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 12: The "Perfect" Case Theory and the CCDC Process
events.outline: A trial isn’t about throwing every fact and legal argument at the court—it’s about strategy. As solicitors, our role is to distill complex information into a clear, compelling story that shows why our client is not guilty. In this seminar, seasoned advocates share practical insights on crafting a powerful case theory, making the tough calls along the way, and navigating the CCDC process where both sides reveal their strategies.

events.title: [WEBINAR] What Is A "Frozen Conflict" in International Law?
events.outline: This event is organised by National University of Singapore, Centre for International Law (NUS CIL). What is a "frozen conflict" in international law? This webinar examines the contested legal meaning of the term, distinguishing frozen conflicts from other contemporary conflicts through a survey of global conflict hotspots. Focusing on the post-Soviet space, Dr. Livia Bonhôte-Enzler explores how these conflicts challenge legal concepts of sovereignty, territorial integrity, self-determination, occupation, and the use of force.

events.title: [WEBINAR] AEICs: The 2026 Paradigm
events.outline: This webinar explores the evolving 2026 paradigm for Affidavits of Evidence in Chief (AEICs) in Singapore civil trials, covering judicial guidance, procedural changes, and technology's growing role. Speakers address best practices for drafting, structuring, and managing factual and expert evidence, integrating electronic material, and avoiding pitfalls. Participants will learn judicial expectations, common AEIC weaknesses, techniques for clarity and persuasiveness, and how to handle cross-examination and submission challenges.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 4: Dispute Resolution+
events.outline: This module is intended to familiarise participants with the different forms of dispute resolution relevant to the restructuring and insolvency contex

events.title: Megaprojects: What Works, What Fails and What’s Next
events.venue: Meeting Room, Level 3, West Tower Marina One, 9 Straits View, Singapore 018937
events.outline: Megaprojects are defined by scale, value & increasingly complex delivery environments. From evolving regulations, compressed delivery timelines to supply chain disruption, stakeholder pressures & shifting commercial realities, project teams operate in more uncertain/challenging conditions. We explore lessons from major projects, how legal frameworks interact with broader aspects, how industry/contractual practices evolve to better manage risk, improve project delivery, achieve better outcomes.

events.title: Multilateralism: The UN Charter and the International Order based on International Law in the 21st Century
events.venue: Ngee Ann Kongsi Auditorium, National Gallery of Singapore, 1 St Andrew's Road, Singapore 178957
events.outline: This event is organised by Attorney-General’s Chambers. The UN Charter celebrated its 80th anniversary in 2025, amidst what some have described as a crisis of multilateralism. The UN is facing cost cutting issues, slow movement in multilateral treaty negotiations, and challenges in resolving intractable armed conflicts. And yet, there have also been triumphs – the BBNJ Agreement came into force in 2026, and the International Court of Justice has been more active than ever, with more cases on its docket than at any other time in its history.

events.title: From Mentorship to Monetisation: People, Protection and Value in IP Practice
events.venue: 10 Collyer Quay, Ocean Financial Centre, 11th Floor, Singapore 049315
events.outline: This event is organised by International Association for the Protection of Intellectual Property (AIPPI Singapore).  This seminar will feature distinguished speakers who will share their expertise on mentorship in the legal profession, intellectual property law, and the valuation of intellectual property and intangible assets. Speakers will provide insights grounded in Singapore practice and international developments

events.title: JLP - Appeals
events.venue: SAL, Stamford 1 & 2, The Adelphi #08-08, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: This training module is designed equip young lawyers with essential and practical skills required to prepare for and handle a civil appeal.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Defending Accused Persons with Invisible Disabilities: Challenges and Practical Considerations
events.outline: The session will also consider the roles that lawyers, mental health professionals, prosecutors and the courts can play in addressing these challenges, as well as practical approaches that defence counsel can adopt when representing clients with invisible disabilities. The presentation will draw on Ms Elizabeth Kelley's experience in the United States while considering how these issues may arise in Singapore’s criminal justice context, including the implications of Singapore’s non-jury system.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 13: Mastering Oral Advocacy: Preparing to Persuade
events.outline: Advocacy is where preparation meets persuasion. In this session, experienced speakers share practical strategies for crafting compelling oral arguments and navigating courtroom dynamics with confidence and professionalism.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Protection, Resilience, and Legal Gaps in Dual – Use Space Systems
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. CIL is pleased to host Protection, Resilience, and Legal Gaps in Dual-Use Space Systems, an online seminar examining challenges in international space law and armed conflict. Chaired by Dr Samuel White, the seminar brings together Kristina Novakovic, Duncan Blake, Robert Rovetto and Dale Stephens to discuss the protection, resilience, targeting and legal gaps surrounding dual-use space systems.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Specialist Arbitration Series: International Trade, Maritime and Shipping Arbitrations (Virtual Edition)
events.outline: Arbitration has become the preferred method of dispute resolution for a wide range of commercial disputes. The Specialist Arbitration Series seeks to shine the spotlight on the different areas of arbitration disputes, the major stakeholders, contractual relationships, key legal principles and types of claims and defences that are typically brought in that area, as well as the issues and strategic considerations to take note of in each stage of the arbitration for that particular area of dispute.

events.title: [WEBINAR] From Principles to Practice: Governing AI and Agentic Systems in Asia’s Fragmented Regulatory Landscape
events.outline: As AI shifts to autonomous agents, legal practitioners face complex compliance risks. This session draws on Europe-Asia comparative jurisprudence to provide a defensible framework for assigning liability, managing cross-border regulatory fragmentation, and engineering accountability by design.

events.title: [WEBINAR] ACRA's Prescribed Anti-Money Laundering Combating the Financing of Terrorism ("AML/CFT") Course
events.outline: This event is organised by Chartered Secretaries Institute Singapore (CSIS). This course intends to equip [Registered Filing Agents (RFAs)] with the knowledge and understanding of anti-money laundering (AML) and counter financing of terrorism (CFT) to enable RFAs to comply with prevailing ACRA and relevant Singapore’s regulatory requirements.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Advocacy in Bail Applications and Closing Arguments
events.outline: Bail affects criminal cases from arrest through appeal. Though straightforward in law, it has practical implications shaping a client's daily experience, mastering both law and practicalities (e.g., bringing a passport to court) boosts perceived competence, while "hiccups" (e.g., unanticipated bail increases with new charges) risk appearing unprofessional. This webinar covers the legal framework, practical scenarios and tips on bail, plus a brief discussion on closing oral arguments at trial.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] International Commercial Mediation Workshop+
events.venue: Webinar / 137 Amoy Street, Far East Square, #03-06, Singapore 049965
events.outline: This event is organised by Sage Mediation Institute for Leadership Education Pte Ltd. This workshop is designed for those new to mediation or for mediators who wish to enhance their skills for a world following the Singapore Convention on Mediation. Led by seasoned international mediators, you will practice mediating cross-cultural conflicts and try different approaches to de-escalate strong negative emotions. This workshop is a mandatory component of those seeking accreditation as international mediators under the Sage Mediation Institute for Leadership Education.

events.title: Family Office Risk Management and Control
events.venue: Wealth Management Institute, One Marina Boulevard, #16-01, Singapore 018989
events.outline: This event is organsied by Wealth Management Institute Limited. The Family Office Risk Management and Controls Programme equips professionals to navigate complex regulations and tax frameworks in family offices. Covers structures, rationale, and key players. Highlights risks in onboarding, complex structures, cross-border issues, and high-risk jurisdictions. Participants will assess and mitigate these risks through compliance strategies and controls, safeguarding Singapore’s standards in transparency, law, and risk management.

events.title: Strategic Conflict Management for Professionals Module 2+
events.venue: Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) The Adelphi, 1 Coleman Street #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This three-day programme conducted by SAL-SMC is highly interactive with role plays and exercises and is taught by experienced faculty. Participants will be able to: Learn advanced concepts in interest-based conflict management Use tried-and-tested mediator strategies and approaches Apply advanced tools for effective communication Recognise the legal and ethical issues in mediation Acquire techniques to overcome impasse Receive insights into drafting settlement agreements.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Building a Professional Brand and Delivering an Impactful Pitch for Legal Professionals (Session 3)
events.outline: This exclusive three-part webinar series is designed to equip legal professionals with the tools, mindset, and strategies to build a compelling personal brand, show up authentically in every interaction, and deliver pitches that win mandates and open doors.

events.title: APAA - Singapore Group Lecture 2026
events.venue: Rooms 4011 and 4111, Level 4, Marina Bay Sands Expo and Convention Centre,  10 Bayfront Avenue, Singapore 018956
events.outline: This event is organised by Asian Patent Attorneys Association – Singapore Group. This lecture will cover developments and case law updates in the United Kingdom and the European Union for intellectual property, financial relief in patent litigation, and practical issues in IP litigation.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Family Conference 2026+
events.venue: Webinar / Family Justice Courts 1 Havelock Square, Singapore 059725
events.outline: Spanning two days, the programme offers a rich mix of plenary sessions, interactive discussions, and collaborative exchanges covering the most pressing issues in family law today, from considering and reshaping the substantive bases for the division of matrimonial assets, the changing legal practice and concerns relating to child welfare, succession and wealth planning, the provision and protection of the vulnerable in the family, the evolving role of technology in family practice, and ethical considerations for a practitioner engaging in modern family & probate practice.

events.title: Advanced Certificate in Law and Technology Module 4: Legal Innovation+
events.outline: In this module, participants will discover the tools and ideas that are driving these big changes. They will also study the principles of innovation and how tech disruption is affecting legal services; from understanding nuances to exploring how they are changing the way lawyers do their jobs.

events.title: STA Conference 2026: Stewardship in a Shifting World
events.venue: Marina bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre, Heliconia Ballroom Level 3, Bayfront Ave, Singapore 018956
events.outline: This event is organised by Singapore Trustees Association. This conference examines recent legal developments and emerging issues in trust law and private client practice. Topics include significant court decisions from Singapore, Jersey and the UK, trustee decision-making, disclosure of trust information, cross-border wealth structuring, succession planning, China developments, non-bankable assets, trustee challenges, and the impact of AI on the trust industry, providing practical insights for trust and private client practitioners.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 14: Rehabilitation Over Retribution: Alternative Sentencing for Youth and Vulnerable Offenders
events.outline: Ensuring that young and vulnerable offenders have the chance to rehabilitate and reintegrate is a matter of public importance. Often, the most effective justice lies not in incarceration, but in meaningful alternatives that support transformation

events.title: Strategic Conflict Management for Professionals Module 1+
events.venue: Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) The Adelphi, 1 Coleman Street #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Strategic Conflict Management for Professionals Module 1 is an intensive two-day training programme conducted by SAL-SMC to learn the foundations of interest-based mediation which focuses on the disputing parties’ interests and encourages a broader range of solutions. You will learn about the nature of conflicts and the most effective techniques to manage them. These fundamental dispute resolution strategies can be applied in diverse situations to manage work relationships within an organisation or with external parties, or to build stronger and more effective teams.

events.title: Certificate for Family Office Advisors - Advanced+
events.venue: Wealth Management Institute, One Marina Boulevard, #16-01, Singapore 018989
events.outline: This event is organised Wealth Management Institute Limited. by This advanced program goes beyond the basics of Family Offices, focusing on the psychology and motivations of today's UHNW families. It explores opportunities such as impact investing, where affluent clients can align their wealth decisions with societal and environmental values, offering insights into the emerging trends in the field.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 5: Forensics And Investigations+
events.outline: This module provides an insight into the types and motivations of fraud and the obligations of an insolvency practitioner when faced with circumstances involving fraud. Participants will be introduced to a series of investigation methodology and the importance of forensic services in uncovering valuable evidence for the insolvency practitioner.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Day of Conveyancing Highlights 2026 – Day 2
events.outline: The Conveyancing Practice Committee presents its 14th annual "Day of Conveyancing Highlights," held as two half-day webinars covering different topics. Speakers include Leonard Tay (Knight Frank) on residential/commercial market trends, S. Suressh (Harry Elias Partnership) on anti-money laundering, Orson Zhu (SLA) on the upcoming Digital Conveyancing Portal, and Carrie Wong (SLA) on adaptive reuse of State properties - addressing property law, market dynamics, technology, and compliance for practitioners.

events.title: Corporate Law Day 2026+
events.outline:
For 2026, the Corporate Law Day event will take place over 2 days, include opportunities for networking,
and will continue to cover topics of particular interest to corporate law practitioners. Organised by
the Corporate Practice Committee, the topics for this year’s event include specialised interests (such
as, tax issues associated with corporate transactions), as well as practical matters and subjects of ongoing discussion (such as, practical guidance on using AI for corporate matters).

events.title: Maritime Arbitrator Accreditation Programme 2026
events.outline: The SCMA’s MAAP comprises two parts: an in-person workshop, consisting of two modules, will be held on 23 September 2026. An online Written Assessment will be held on 24 September 2026. Module 1: Statutory and Rule Framework for Maritime Arbitration – 2.5 hours. Module 2: Drafting the Award and Practical Issues – 2.5 hours.

events.title: From Trusted Advisor to Strategic Ally: Mastering Stakeholder Management for In-house Counsel
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline:
This course is designed for those who seek to enhance their effectiveness by mastering the art of stakeholder management. It is particularly beneficial for those looking to improve communication, build stronger internal and external relationships, and strategically navigate complex organizational dynamics. 

Participants will leave this course with actionable strategies, practical tools, and enhanced confidence to effectively manage their stakeholders, strengthen their influence within the organization, and drive better legal and business outcomes.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CLAS Training Programme 2026 - Module 15: Navigating Sexual Offence Cases: Legal Developments and Cross-Examination Strategies
events.outline: The last decade has seen a rise in sexual crime cases in Singapore. Join us for an in-depth discussion on how legislative changes, sentencing frameworks, and institutional responses are shaping the prosecution and defence of sexual assault cases.

events.title: Lexplorer Workshop Series 3: The Confident Middle - Redefining Success for Women in Law
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: The session will combine short conceptual inputs with facilitated discussion using practical case studies drawn from real-world legal contexts.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Advocacy Fundamentals in Examination-In-Chief and Cross-Examination
events.outline: This is Session 3 of 4 webinars held in the lead-up to the Law Society's Criminal Trial Advocacy Course (CTAC) on 25 September 2026. This session introduces essential advocacy skills for examination-in-chief and cross-examination in criminal cases, covering how to structure examinations, elicit admissible evidence, avoid common pitfalls, and maintain control of witness evidence.

events.title: SIArb Fellowship Assessment Course 2026 - Workshop 2 to 6+
events.outline: FAC will focus on teaching candidates the practical aspects of acting as an Arbitrator.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Urgent Applications Without Notice: A Practical Guide for Pragmatic Practitioners
events.outline:
Urgent, without-notice applications demand speed and precision in taking instructions. This session offers practical guidance for handling these matters with confidence.
Topics covered include what to do when an urgent matter lands on your desk, key aspects such as full and frank disclosure and undertakings as to damages and the mechanics of getting matters heard urgently, including skeletal submissions under the Rules of Court 2021, as well as freezing/proprietary injunctions and search orders.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 6: Financial Assessment+
events.outline: Financial assessment is a key and integral part of a restructuring and insolvency practice. It is an essential skill in determining the solvency or otherwise of an organisation that is undergoing restructuring or insolvency. This module will equip participants with the knowledge and skills that are required to perform such financial assessment.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Establishing Fraud, Unconscionable Conduct and Beyond
events.outline: This programme will address two distinct yet interconnected topics: fraud and unconscionable conduct in the context of financial instruments, and the practical considerations involved in establishing fraud in legal cases.

events.title: Self-Leadership for Lawyers: Taking Charge of your Work Life - Module 2
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This session participants will learn about purpose, values and strengths, the relevance of these in their legal work (and personal lives) and how using these can promote self-leadership and support a sustainable career in the legal profession.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Senior Counsel Forum 2026 - Module 6: The UK perspective – Ethical Issues in AI and Lawyer’s Role in Administration of Justice
events.outline: The Senior Counsel Forum, by the Law Society of Singapore, returns with six modules led by distinguished Senior Counsel. Topics include court submissions, duty to the court, disciplinary processes, conflicts of interest, common ethical scenarios, and English ethics practice. An invaluable opportunity for lawyers to learn best practices in legal ethics, delivered virtually via Zoom.

events.title: CML Seminar Series: Who Should Pay When AI Goes Wrong? Producer Liability for Autonomous Ships under English Law
events.venue: The Executive Centre Level 22 Ocean Financial Centre 10 Collyer Quay Singapore 049315
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: As Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) adopt AI for tasks traditionally handled by crews, questions arise over liability when AI causes cargo damage. While claims will usually target carriers, cargo owners and insurers may also pursue AI producers. This seminar argues that existing English negligence law can address AI-related issues, including defect, evidence, causation and remoteness, without new liability rules, and examines implications for insurers and contractual risk allocation.

events.title: JLP - Effective Business Negotiation
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This one-day programme equips participants with a structured negotiation approach, practical communication tools, and strategies to handle resistance and rejection in client-facing negotiations. The workshop uses client-relevant scenarios to ensure learning is immediately transferable to real-world negotiation challenges in reinsurance and related commercial discussions.

events.title: Distinguished Visitor Lecture: New Era, New Concepts: Innovation and Development in China’s Company Law (2023) and Its Judicial Interpretations
events.venue: Wee Chong Jin Moot Court, NUS Law
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This seminar examines China’s 2023 Company Law revision and its judicial interpretations. It explores the law’s new principles, including stronger corporate governance, shareholder and creditor protection, and corporate social responsibility. Key reforms include changes to registered capital, directors’ duties, minority shareholder rights, simplified structures for small firms, and creditor safeguards, alongside their practical impact on governance and business practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Ponzi Insolvencies Across Jurisdictions
events.outline: This webinar examines modern Ponzi insolvencies, and the various legal, commercial and strategic issues that can arise. It delves into clawback litigation, tracing and recovery strategies, cross-border enforcement issues, and also cryptocurrency-related recovery challenges that arise through such insolvencies today. A number of jurisdictions are covered, from Singapore, US, and the UK.

events.title: Public Lecture on Climate Change “Legal and Scientific (Un)certainties: 10 Years after the Paris Agreement”
events.venue: NUS Bukit Timah Campus, Block B, Seminar Room 4-4, Singapore 259756
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. The Paris Agreement is now fully operational, with Parties required to submit new nationally determined contributions (NDC 3.0) for 2035 that are more ambitious and informed by the first global stocktake. As implementation takes centre stage, geopolitical tensions, technological advances, and competing commercial interests challenge effective climate governance. This seminar examines how international law can provide legal stability and strengthen the rule of law in climate action.

events.title: Integrated IP, Valuation & Tax (IIVT): A Strategic Toolkit for Decision-Makers+
events.outline:
IP Identification & Strategic Positioning
-Start from business strategy
-Identify the IP/IA that enables the strategy
-Prioritise and position IP/IA for competitive advantage

IP Commercialisation, Licensing & Structuring
-Commercialisation pathways for IP/IA
-Allocation of rights, obligations, and control
-Implementation and control

IP Due Diligence in M&A & Restructuring
-Objectives and scope of IP due diligence
-Common IP issues and early warning signs
-Dependence on IP and ability to operate

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 7: Business Valuation+
events.outline: This module will approach the subject of business valuation by navigating through the International Valuation Standards (IVS), focusing on the process, the various approaches and methods, and the challenges commonly encountered in their application.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Energy Justice and Just Transition
events.outline: This webinar is organised by NUS - Centre for International Law. This lecture introduces energy justice and its relevance to energy poverty, inequality, and climate change. It examines the five tenets of energy justice and their practical application, including trade-offs between affordability, energy security, and justice. The lecture then explores just transition in the energy sector within international climate law and policy, and concludes by considering the challenges of balancing transition speed, fairness, and implementation.

events.title: Self-Leadership for Lawyers: Taking Charge of your Work Life - Module 3
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This session, participants will learn about the optimal and sub-optimal impacts of stimulation vs stress on the way we think, feel, and act, and how to better regulate ourselves towards the “just right” place for greater sustainability and effectiveness.

events.title: Integrating ESG into Corporate Governance and Compliance
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: The course aims to equip inhouse counsel and private practitioners with an understanding of the key concepts and issues relating to sustainability and ESG and how to incorporate such concepts into corporate policies and strategies, ensuring they are equipped to advise organisations on best practices and compliance with relevant regulations

events.title: [WEBINAR] Tort Claims in Employment Disputes: Recent Developments
events.outline: This seminar examines the evolving role of tort claims in employment disputes with reference to recent Singapore court decisions as well as case law from other common law jurisdictions where applicable.

events.title: JLP - Costs and Enforcement
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Get equipped with a thorough understanding of P&P and S&C costs, and enforcement of judgments and awards, blending legal theory with practical skills to prepare them for the challenges they may face in their work.

events.title: Sanctions for Legal Ethical Breaches – Determining the Appropriate Sanction for Lawyer Misconduct
events.venue: SUSS Room at the State Courts
events.outline: This seminar focuses on the topic of sanctions, i.e. the punishment which an errant lawyer may face owing to breaches of the legal ethical norms. The aim of the seminar is two-fold: First, to provide a general introduction to the topic of sanctions. Second, to explore in detail the court’s approach in determining the appropriate sanction for a legal ethical breach and to offer guidance in this regard based on the existing case law.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (8 October)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: Certificate in Family Office & Governance
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This module introduces the family office landscape, core functions, and role within the private wealth ecosystem. It covers family governance structures, constitutions, councils, ownership and board dynamics, and alignment of values and roles. Participants also examine family dynamics, cultural influences, conflict management, and the legal professional’s role, supported by case studies and practical discussions.

events.title: The Law Society Criminal Trial Advocacy Course 2026+
events.outline:
Following a successful 1st edition in October 2025, the Law Society of Singapore's Advocacy Committee will be working with criminal barristers from the Australian Bar Association for the 2nd edition of the Criminal Trial Advocacy Course.

With a slate of pre-course webinars, experienced speakers from various sides of the criminal justice system and interactive workshops, this Course will broaden your perspectives, sharpen your advocacy skills and enhance your preparation for a criminal trial.
